name: 77040 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77040 (Houston) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77040 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77040 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
